description: BB edge case: period equals the number of closes (len=5, period=5). Output length = 5-5+1 = 1 (single window covering the entire input). Closes=[10,12,11,13,12]; mean=(10+12+11+13+12)/5=11.6; sumSq=(2.56+0.16+0.36+1.96+0.16)=5.2; stdDev=sqrt(5.2/5)=sqrt(1.04)=1.019804; upper=11.6+2*1.019804=13.639608; lower=11.6-2*1.019804=9.560392. Population stdDev (divisor N). Verifies no off-by-one error at the boundary where period==len.

expectedOutput.note: Single window: period==len(closes). mean=11.6, stdDev=sqrt(1.04)=1.019804. Output has exactly 1 triple. No ErrInsufficientData (len >= period is satisfied).
